svg.text: Multi-driver interval (proposed) vs unconstrained, fixed-parameter, and probabilistic baselines · synthesised on realistic residential load curves with morning shoulder, midday AC plateau, evening peak, and post-peak rebound

Four methods compared at the scenario peak hour
Each panel shows the 24-h DR response envelope at node 30 for one typical day. Proposed interval (solid red band) sits between the unconstrained joint-sampling band (blue) and the fixed-parameter
midpoint trace (dashed black); the probabilistic 90% CI (yellow dotted) is a tighter percentile cut by construction. The right inset compares peak-hour widths across methods and scenarios.
